title: Chapter 508 - 508 Return; It’Ll Be Successful As Long As It’S Built (2)
content:
Chapter 508 - 508 Return; It’Ll Be Successful As Long As It’S Built (2)

Chapter 508 - 508 Return; It’ll Be Successful as Long as It’s Built (2)

508 Return; It’ll Be Successful as Long as It’s Built (2)

“I think that only by balancing work and rest can we improve our learning efficiency!” Hao Zhiwu said righteously.

Lin Fan listened to their conversation and could not help but laugh. “Alright, go play if you want to.”

He had never been a strict professor, nor was he a hardworking professor.

It was good to balance work and rest.

…

At this moment, the phone in Lin Fan’s pocket rang.

He looked at the caller ID and saw that it was Feng Zhixiang, the director of the Institute of Science.

Lin Fan did not hesitate and answered the call.

“Good afternoon, Professor Lin!” Feng Zhixiang’s respectful voice came from the other end.

“Good afternoon, Director Feng,” Lin Fan said. “What’s the matter?”

He never liked to beat about the bush, so he asked directly.

Feng Zhixiang was not too surprised by this.

After all, both sides had dealt with each other many times.

“I just received news that the Totamac device you purchased has arrived at the port,” Feng Zhixiang said. “I’m now preparing to get someone to ship it to Ordinary Technology. Do you want to come over and take a look?”

It had to be said that the IN Physics Institute was very efficient.

In such a short period of time, the item had been transported over.

Of course, the main reason was that Lin Fan had given too much money.

Lin Fan’s heart skipped a beat. The Totamac device had arrived?

One had to know…

His mission required him to read five books, own a Totamac machine, and a controllable nuclear fusion plant that covered more than 10,000 acres.

He had already read all five books.

Although he had purchased the Totamac device, he had not been able to fulfill the mission requirements.

Lin Fan suspected that he had to wait for the Totamac device to arrive in Hua Nation before it would be ticked off.

Thinking of this, Lin Fan said, “Alright, I’ll go to Ordinary Technology now.”

After hanging up the call, he asked Hao Zhiwu and the others to continue their self-study.

Then, he drove the Cullinan out.

The last time he came here, there was only a dilapidated road, a few small mounds, and a few dilapidated factories.

At this moment, the road had already been widened by two times. The small mound and the dilapidated factory had long disappeared…

In its place were tall factories and the main office building.

It could be said that the structure of the controllable nuclear fusion plant was slowly taking shape.

Dozens of engineering vehicles and hundreds of workers were seen working very hard.

At this moment, two soldiers walked over with their backs straight.

“Hello, what’s the matter?”

Their voices were steady and powerful.

His factory was actually guarded by soldiers!

Lin Fan was just about to speak…

At this moment, an Audi drove over from afar.

Behind the Audi was a van.

Soon, Feng Zhixiang and a middle-aged man wearing gold-rimmed glasses walked down.

“Professor Lin, sorry for being late,” Feng Zhixiang greeted from afar.

Lin Fan said, “It’s fine. I just arrived.”

The two soldiers stepped aside after hearing this.

Feng Zhixiang explained, “For the safety of Ordinary Technology, we arranged for some soldiers to guard it.”

Lin Fan’s face revealed a strange look.

Ordinary Technology was wholly invested by him.

Soldiers were sent to guard this place?

Feng Zhixiang seemed to have noticed Lin Fan’s confusion and continued, “After all, this is a controllable nuclear fusion company. As long as it involves nuclear energy, we have to be careful.”

Lin Fan nodded.

Then, Feng Zhixiang pointed at the truck and said, “The Totamac device is inside…”

Lin Fan looked in the direction he was pointing at. A crane was lifting a strange-looking machine out of the truck.

The middle-aged man wearing the gold-rimmed glasses could not help but say, “Professor Lin, may I ask, why did you spend so much money to buy a second-generation Totamac device from the IN Physics Institute?”

His words were filled with confusion.

There were two main directions for controllable nuclear fusion research.

One was a stellarator, and the other was a Totamac device.

Among them, the stellarator was a path recognized by most scholars. It was also the main research direction in Hua Nation and was at the forefront of the world.

As for the Totamac device, it was much more unpopular.

In fact, many scholars believed that it was the wrong path.

As a result, Hua Nation chose to give up on researching the Totamac device.

On top of the stellarator, Lin Fan should study the Totamac device, or at least buy the third generation of the Totamac device, right?

One had to know…

The current Totomac device was already in the fifth generation, and it was said that the sixth generation would soon appear soon.

Then, what was the use of the second-generation stellarator that Lin Fan had bought?

It would not be an exaggeration to say that it was junk, right?

Spending so much money to buy a piece of junk!

No wonder the middle-aged man was so confused.

“Professor Lin, this is Director Wang Dahua from the Institute of Nuclear Physics at Capital University.”

Lin Fan did not reply immediately. Instead, he focused his attention on the mission system.

[Mission: Build a nuclear fusion plant of more than 10,000 acres (0/1), own a Totamac device (1/1), and read Particle Simulation of Plasmas, Manual of Plasma Physics and Formulas, Physics of Thermonuclear Fusion Plasmas, Controlled Nuclear Fusion (5/5). Reward: Complete version of the nuclear fusion device, as well as related knowledge such as principles and design drawings, Professor-Level Physics Experience +1 upgrade, one platinum packet.]

As expected, the mission was only confirmed and completed when the Totamac device appeared in front of him.

After a while, Lin Fan said, “Because if I buy this Totamac machine, I can successfully develop controllable nuclear fusion.”

“Really?” Feng Zhixiang asked excitedly. “The research is going to be successful?”

It was no wonder that he would react like this.

There were too many things involved in controllable nuclear fusion.

The first and second industrial revolutions could both be described as energy revolutions.

Once the controllable nuclear fusion was completed, it would be enough to set off the third industrial revolution.

At that time, Hua Nation would be able to develop by leaps and bounds!

“Professor Lin, is what you said true?” Wang Dahua asked in surprise.

Lin Fan looked at the two of them and said, “It’s useless to talk about this now. The factory of Ordinary Technology hasn’t been built yet. Let’s build a factory of more than 10,000 acres first.

“By then, controllable nuclear fusion will be successful.”

When Lin Fan said this, he was very sure.

The system had never disappointed him.

As long as he completed the mission, he would have the technology for controllable nuclear fusion.

Lin Fan’s goal today was to personally come and see the Totamac device and complete the mission.

Now, everything was done.

There was no need for him to stay any longer.

After Lin Fan said a few words to Feng Zhixiang, Wang Dahua, and the others, he drove the Cullinan away.

After Lin Fan left, Wang Dahua could not help but say, “Director Feng, do you think Professor Lin can really develop controllable nuclear fusion just by relying on the second-generation Totamac device that the IN Physics Institute researched many years ago and has long since eliminated?”

“How long have those mathematicians been studying Riemann’s Hypothesis?” Feng Zhixiang asked. “Did they manage to answer it in the end? How long have those medical experts been studying diabetes? Did they solve it in the end? How long have those physicists been studying earthquakes? Did they invent the earthquake prediction device in the end? How long have those mathematicians been researching batteries? Did they invent the super battery in the end?”

One question after another, he directly asked Wang Dahua till the latter’s jaw was agape. He was unable to answer at all.

“Some people are like that!” Feng Zhixiang continued. “To be able to do things that others can’t, I call this kind of person a great man!”

Feng Zhixiang looked in the direction where Lin Fan had left.

Then, he recalled what Lin Fan had said.

“There are still too few workers and engineering vehicles here. We have to transfer more over!”

After all, Lin Fan said that once the construction was completed, the controllable nuclear fusion would be a success!
